analyst.description: Collaboratively defines product behavior, evaluates confidence, and recommends solution directions

planner.description: Turns an approved feature definition and targeted repository evidence into an implementation plan

explorer.description: Answers focused discovery, planning, or bugfix questions with repository evidence

builder.description: Implements bounded normal development tasks and proportionate verification

reviewer.description: Performs an independent, read-only review against the approved feature definition and repository constraints

shipper.description: Verifies shipping preconditions, creates a focused commit, and pushes the current branch
